classifications.source_derived: value taken from a normative source with its locator
classifications.source_scale_adapted: normative value adapted to this repository's topology; the adaptation is stated
classifications.engineering_assumption: value no source supplies, chosen for a stated engineering reason
classifications.declared_experiment_choice: a choice that defines the experiment, declared before running
classifications.software_policy: a software convention with no physical content

rows.title: Camera response model, preset and supported EM-gain regime
rows.rationale: CCD (read 3 e-, the R3 contextual value), EMCCD (G = 300 in the Gamma high-gain regime, pre-register CIC 0.005 e-/px/read) and CMOS (per-pixel offset, gain and lognormal read-noise maps) synthetic presets; coupled EMCCD for milestone B
rows.limitation: synthetic_assumed engineering presets without a datasheet (no D6); CIC is pre-register only; intermediate EM gains are rejected

rows.title: Pixel scale and centroid-window field of view
rows.rationale: 2 m: the base profile's FFT scale (pad 3) with an odd 23 px window (21 px for the MFT profile); 12/42 m: lambda/(2 d) at 700 nm with a 15 px window so the field stays inside one far-field period at 600 nm
rows.transformation: pixel scale = lambda/(pad n_s dx) of the base profile, dx = D/(N-1)
rows.limitation: the 15 px window spans 7.5 lambda/d at 700 nm; broadened spots clip earlier than in the 23 px ESO tiers

rows.title: Detector-plane sampling and optical oversampling
rows.rationale: legacy FFT point sampling for milestone A; Gauss-Legendre pixel quadrature with k = 4 (2 at 42 m for cost) for milestone B, where the erf oracle meets 1e-6 at k = 4
rows.limitation: k = 2 at 42 m trades pixel-integration accuracy (~1e-4 relative) for run time

rows.title: Charge diffusion, electronic coupling, placement and boundary
rows.rationale: diffusion sigma 0.25 px (2 m) and 0.2 px (12/42 m, keeps the margin to one pixel), truncated at 5 sigma; coupling only in the coupled EMCCD preset (1 % nearest, 0.2 % diagonal) after saturation and before read noise, zero boundary at the block edge with a one-pixel guard ring
rows.limitation: synthetic values; light of neighbouring lenslets is not modelled in a block; the coupling placement is a model assumption (D8 describes CMOS IPC)

rows.title: WFS bandpass, wavelength quadrature and spectral weights
rows.rationale: milestone A: monochromatic 700 nm carrying a 550-850 nm bandwidth for photometry; milestone B: the R3 contextual sensing band 0.6-0.9 um with 3 Gauss-Legendre nodes weighted by detected electrons (flat in photon number per wavelength for direct budgets)
rows.limitation: 3 nodes; quadrature convergence verified to 2e-3 px between 5 and 7 nodes on the 2 m fixture

rows.title: Source budget, magnitude system, area, throughput and QE accounting
rows.rationale: AB magnitudes (Oke & Gunn zero point) with throughput 0.4 excluding QE and the camera's QE applied once; bright-star settings m = 5 (CCD, CMOS) and 7 (EMCCD) at 2 m, m = 8 for the 12 m EMCCD (register capacity), R4's 1e5 per frame per subaperture read as detected photoelectrons at 42 m; per-subaperture budgets scale with illuminated area
rows.limitation: R4 states photons, not electrons; reading it as detected electrons keeps the 42 m tier comparable with eso_drm_42m_scao_derived@2

rows.title: Sky surface brightness
rows.rationale: 20.5 mag/arcsec^2, a dark-sky visible value, constant in f_nu across the band; null for the direct 42 m budget
rows.limitation: not site data; negligible at these pixel scales and exposures

rows.title: Calibration-frame protocol and product definitions
rows.rationale: estimated products from 32 frames each (16 at 42 m for cost), flat at 1000 input e- per pixel; B = bias mean, D = dark mean - B, S = sky mean - B - D, flat = (flat mean - B - D) normalized over valid pixels
rows.limitation: no shared input frames between products; products fixed per run and regenerated only with a new calibration realization

rows.title: Bad-pixel detection thresholds and policy
rows.unit: input e- per frame; normalized flat
rows.rationale: hot threshold about six times the dark-master noise of each camera; flat outside [0.5, 1.5] is bad; zero weight
rows.limitation: interpolation is available but not used by the profiles

rows.title: Finite-exposure sub-sample count
rows.rationale: 1: the DET-08 study is opt-in and measured separately
rows.limitation: the time quadrature study at 12 m needs enablement

rows.title: Controller gain selection for noise-on profiles
rows.rationale: predeclared scan over {0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5} with max |pole| <= 0.98; the lowest second-half residual wins, ties within 2 % go to the lower gain (det09_gain_scan.json)
rows.limitation: selected on 3 atmosphere realizations; 12/42 m gains scanned on the ci geometry

rows.title: Detector-pixel layout and immutable pixel IDs
rows.rationale: isolated lenslet blocks keyed by stable subaperture IDs; maps drawn per physical block
rows.limitation: synthetic non-overlapping layout, not a real detector geometry

rows.title: Gain knowledge, EM/input-electron conversion and clipping
rows.rationale: conversion and EM gain are known engineering inputs applied once (per-pixel CMOS gain applied as known conversion gain, the flat then carries PRNU only); no negative clipping, so the centre of gravity stays first-order
rows.limitation: no gain estimation; gain errors are outside the model

rows.title: Uncertainty-model validity domain; temporal versus persistent calibration error
rows.rationale: detector_covariance_v2 (detector.noise_model.UNCERTAINTY_MODEL_ID) is supported only for a plain centre of gravity (no threshold, no minimum subtraction), without negative clipping or a declared non-linearity, with no expected saturation above 90 % of the pixel, EM-register or ADC capacity, with every block pixel's expected ADC code (bias and offset map included) at least 5 temporal noise sigmas inside both ADC limits, with read noise of at least half an ADC step on every pixel that enters the centroid (its own read-noise and gain maps, ADC on), with a positive window total and with SNR_T >= 7; its conditional mean, Jacobian, flux and SNRs subtract what the processing actually removes (the realized masters); the temporal sigma, conditional on those fixed masters, gates validity, and the calibration-ensemble sigma, linearized about the nominal background, is reported separately (centroid_calibration_sigma_px) as a persistent per-run bias
rows.limitation: outside the domain the model reports an undefined sigma and the lenslet is invalid; first order, it reads low by about 4/SNR_T^2 near the SNR_T floor (E1); its Monte Carlo checks used Gaussian fixture spots (E1, tests/detector/test_noise_model.py) and, in open loop, the profiles' own lenslet optics (E2); the formula itself assumes no spot shape

rows.title: Neutral compatibility detector block and exposure clock
rows.rationale: the camera preset owns noise and QE and the source block owns the budget, so the legacy detector block is neutral and only carries the exposure, equal to the frame period
rows.limitation: none

rows.title: Validity gating on the uncertainty-model domain instead of the peak-pixel SNR gate (version 2, post-hoc)
rows.rationale: E3 on @1 showed the inherited peak-pixel SNR gate (3) rejects lenslets with total SNR ~20 from m_AB ~ 9.5 and collapses the loop at m_AB = 10; @2 sets it to 0 and relies on SNR_T >= 7 (validated domain) and sigma <= 0.5 px; recorded reason, the affected experiments are rerun on @2; the decision, and E3 and E4 on @2, were made and produced under detector_covariance_v1 (2026-10-16, before commit 573f875), and those records keep that identity; runs of @2, and of @3, which inherits the gate, on current code gate on detector_covariance_v2 (B14), whose SNR_T is formed from the conditional mean on the realized masters
rows.limitation: changed after inspecting E3; @1 keeps the predeclared gate and its results stand

rows.title: Bright internal calibration source (version 2)
rows.unit: detected e- per full subaperture per frame
rows.rationale: 2500 e- (an m_AB = 8 equivalent at 12 m for the EMCCD) for reference centroids and interaction probes, without sky; @1 calibrated at the operating flux and refused to build from m_AB = 11
rows.limitation: the internal source has the operating spectral weights; its sky-free reference differs from the operating sky pedestal only by the sky master (about 1e-4 e- per pixel)

rows.title: Reconstructor Tikhonov damping (version 3, post-hoc)
rows.unit: relative to the RMS column norm
rows.rationale: 0.1 (was 0.001): 0.001 leaves the global waffle mode (singular value 0.0265 of the RMS column norm) unregularized, and its noise-driven wander latched the loop up at m_AB = 11; 0.1 damps waffle by 15x and leaves the median mode at 0.99 of its gain; selected on root seeds 11 and 12 (0.03, 0.1, 0.3) and evaluated, predeclared, on root seeds 21-25 (det_excursion_e3_12m_v2.json)
rows.limitation: changed after inspecting E3 on @2; selected at m_AB = 11 on the 12 m geometry only; @2 keeps 0.001 and its results stand

rows.title: Closed-loop recovery policy (version 3)
rows.unit: frames; fraction of the command removed per frame; null = off
rows.rationale: reset the DM to flat after two consecutive rejected frames (det_recovery_e3_12m_v2.json); with the version-3 damping no frame is rejected at m_AB 10-11 on the evaluation seeds, so it is a safety net that never acts there; the subset fallback and the gain schedule stay off (null): neither recovered the loop in that evaluation
rows.limitation: a reset costs about 20 frames of re-closing when it fires

rows.title: Noise-on reconstruction validity floor
rows.rationale: 0.75 (the 2 m base profiles required 1.0, which freezes the DM on the first noise-invalidated lenslet); the ESO tiers keep 0.5
rows.limitation: none

rows.title: Values inherited unchanged from the base profile
rows.rationale: geometry, atmosphere, DM, calibration, reconstructor kind, command projector, loop timing and science settings are the base profile's; ESO-derived tiers are traced by eso_drm_42m_scao_derived.assumptions.v2.json
rows.limitation: the 2 m base (fast_2m_detector@4) is a synthetic engineering profile without its own ledger

revisions.change: rationale, limitation and consuming tests describe detector_covariance_v2; the consuming tests add the support-domain gate tests and the calibration-ensemble test
revisions.reason: v1 described detector_covariance_v1 (2026-10-15), which formed the conditional mean from the ideal background, checked only the upper ADC limit without offsets and applied the quantization rule with the scalar read noise; it was replaced on 2026-10-16 (573f875, review R2 and R4), and the 2026-10-18 correction (pre-refactor audit F-01) made the quantization gate per pixel without changing the identifier

revisions.change: the title names the current gating domain; the rationale records that the decision and its evidence were produced under detector_covariance_v1; its consuming tests are its own list (unchanged content), no longer shared with B14
revisions.reason: roadmap G11: current semantics and historical producer version must be distinct

historical_producers: evidence cited by rows B11 (det09_gain_scan.json), B18 (E3 on @1 and E3 and E4 on @2), B20 (det_excursion_e3_12m_v2.json) and B21 (det_recovery_e3_12m_v2.json) was produced before 573f875, under detector_covariance_v1; those records keep their identities and are not attributed to the current model
